plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence published on catalog p. 313 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; Certificate of Proficiency requires POSCI 35, POSCI 36, and POSCI 451 (8-10 units). POSCI 451 is printed '2-4' units; the lower bound 2 is used (Fall term prints '5-7'). Catalog footnotes: students must complete a minimum of two units of COPED (cooperative work experience) over at least two semesters (max three units per semester); the sequence footnote adds that POSCI 451 may also be taken in Spring. No hard prerequisites listed in the sequence; prereq lists are empty per standard and documented. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
